breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the load as a uniform distributed load (w = 1.5 N/mm) applied along the entire length of the beam, without replacing it with a resultant force at midspan. This matches the ground truth prompt and avoids the incorrect approximation described in the inconsistency.
